summary: Resolve original launch and revision attention locators from accepted approval actors

replay.detail: Read-only helpers use durable planning-session.approved and revision-proposal.created/approved claims, not mutable projection ownership.

schema.detail: No tables or indexes added. Main approved existing claims_subject_kind_index lookups under fractal_store::store::attention_launch_resolution: one subject, 1 MiB JSON parse cap, scalar-only output bounded to 4096-byte identity and 40-byte timestamp. Source-site inventory lv-h86dfd7785502 records the dynamic query sink.

rules.detail: Launch requires exact original requester and preview hash; revision requires original reviewer, generation, preview and that reviewer's actual approval. Missing proofs return None without inference.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Parent integrates the shared SourceResolution type, module registry and native-ID endpoint dispatch.

recovery.detail: Read-only change; rollback does not change stored claims.
